In an audit report issued by an audit team of the U.S. Customs and Border Protection (“CBP”), CBP concluded that Tenaris should have paid antidumping duties on imports of mechanical and other pipe, which CBP believes to be subject to the antidumping orders on OCTG from Argentina and Mexico. CBP’s audit report calculated loss of revenue to the United States of approximately $49.6 million for years 2022, 2023 and 2024. However, CBP also appears to indicate that its calculation will be adjusted to conform with any clarification of the scope of the relevant OCTG orders that the DOC may issue.
